oneOf.description: A document or a tool's arguments do not satisfy their JSON Schema.
The document's schema_version is not supported.
A reference does not resolve to exactly one target.
A module the bundle depends on is absent.
A semantic rule of the IR is violated.
The references or dependencies form a cycle.
The expected revision differs from the stored revision.
A geometry reference matches more than one entity.
A geometry reference matches no entity.
A stored geometry reference no longer matches its signature.
The referenced geometry is not visible in the drawing view.
A geometry reference was resolved with low confidence.
The compiler could not produce an execution plan.
The IR uses a feature the compiler does not support.
The compiled execution plan failed its own validation.
A command exceeded its time limit; it was not resent and may have run.
The job was cancelled.
The job was interrupted before it finished (for example by a core crash); its outcome is unknown.
The user interrupted the job in SOLIDWORKS.
No job or execution matches the given ID.
The target document has unsaved changes.
The operation ID was already applied; the original result is returned.
The connection to SOLIDWORKS was lost; the operation may have run.
SOLIDWORKS is busy with another operation.
A SOLIDWORKS dialog or UI state blocks the operation.
SOLIDWORKS reported a rebuild error.
The document is read-only in SOLIDWORKS.
More than one SOLIDWORKS session could serve the request.
The SOLIDWORKS version is not supported.
The backend lacks a capability the operation needs.
One or more drawing checks failed; reported in the drawing report (a failed check is a result, not a tool error)
The re-layout limits were reached while a hard drawing check was still failing.
The part cannot be drawn by the drawing pipeline.
Writing to a source file is not allowed.
The path is outside the allowed locations.
The project store is locked by another writer.
The project store failed an integrity check.
The configuration is invalid.
The file does not exist or is not a file.
A project store file cannot be read or written.
One or more part verification checks failed.
A native call failed or its read-back disagreed; details.effect says whether the document may have changed.
A built feature failed its verification contract; details.node and details.checks name it.
